title: FaithBench: A Diverse Hallucination Benchmark for Summarization by Modern LLMs

live_model.evidence: Table 2: "GPT-4-Turbo w/ simple, zero-shot prompt (Luo et al., 2023) 55.96 42.16" (BA%, F1-M%) as a hallucination detector.

prompt.location: Table 2 cites the exact source prompts: zero-shot prompt from Luo et al. (2023), CoT prompt from FACTS (Jacovi et al., 2025)
prompt.note: Prompt provenance is precisely cited to two external papers rather than reprinted verbatim in this paper's own appendix (not confirmed otherwise).

claim.metric: Balanced Accuracy (BA), hallucination detection, zero-shot prompt
claim.location: Table 2, row 'GPT-4-Turbo w/ simple, zero-shot prompt'; "final benchmark totals at 750 samples (75 passages x 10 LLMs)" (Sec 2.3)

data.source: FaithBench (summaries from 10 modern LLMs, human-annotated); authors state annotations 'will be made open source to the public'

notes: o3-mini also qualifies with a clean number in the same table (BA 58.87% zero-shot / 58.18% CoT). GPT-4-Turbo is used here as a hallucination detector (LLM-as-a-judge) whose own detection accuracy against human labels is the reported metric, analogous to a detector/classifier role rather than free-form generation.
